descriptor: Delivery address entry that does the typing

voice.summary: Sounds like a courier who just wants to get it right: short questions, instant confirmation and no jargon. Errors are specific and always say how to fix them.
dos: Ask one thing at a time
Confirm the address back in full
Name the field when something is wrong
donts: Never make people retype what we already know

boilerplate: Doorstep is an address form component that suggests matching addresses as you type, fills in street, city and postcode, and confirms the result before checkout.

microcopy.error: We couldn't find that address. Check it or enter it manually.
microcopy.empty: Start typing to see matching addresses.

logo.note: A simple house shape says delivery destination at a glance.
